svg.text: CVA6 Trap Entry & MTVEC Vectoring Waveform — EBREAK (Cycles 414 – 426)
Execution of EBREAK at 0x8000_0070 triggers Cause 3 at Cyc 417, asserting full pipeline flushes (BP/IF/ID/EX) and redirecting FetchPC to MTVEC (0x8000_00a0).

• Cyc 417: Commit unit encounters EBREAK; asserts ExValid=1 with ExceptionCause=3. Simultaneously, controller.sv asserts FlushBP=1, FlushIF=1, FlushID=1, FlushEX=1. • Cyc 418: FetchPC is redirected to MTVEC (0x8000_00a0); CSRs latch mepc=0x8000_0070 and mcause=0x3. In Cyc 424, first handler instruction commits.
